headline: Australian MP Helen Haines critically injured in deliberate vehicle strike
deck: Police say the suspected targeting outside Helen Haines’s Wangaratta office was isolated, while a 43-year-old man faces three charges.
body: Helen Haines, an independent Australian federal MP, was struck by a Toyota Land Cruiser outside her office in Wangaratta on Monday in what Prime Minister Anthony Albanese called a deliberate act. [E2]
Haines underwent surgery overnight and remained in critical condition in a Melbourne hospital; Australian media reported that she lost a leg. [E3]
ABC reported that Victoria Police laid three charges against Brendan Nugent, 43, after he allegedly struck Haines with his car. [E4]
In its initial account, Victoria Police described the driver as a 43-year-old man from Tarrawingee and said a passerby arrested him at the scene after he exited the Toyota. [E5]
Police said the accused would be held overnight for a Wangaratta Magistrates’ Court appearance the following day. [E6]
The Australian Federal Police said the alleged targeting appeared to be an isolated incident and that no further threats connected to it were known. [E1]
